listing.name: BLACK (Xbox) (black-pc)
listing.summary: Research listing. Upstream route: Windows x86 compatibility/native execution package Limits: Direct original Xbox x86 execution through compatibility services; upstream says fully playable, Linux uses Wine. Upstream platforms: Windows x86/32-bit compatibility runtime, runs on64-bit Windows. Linux route uses Wine with native DXVK libraries, not a native Linux game package. Original data: Own BLACK original Xbox NTSC-U or PAL Europe full extracted disc data in game/. Required default.xbe SHA-256: NTSC-U DF2739C372D254A90AEECCF5971D12097F22D89FBB90DB021FDA96DD4DEB68F6; PAL Europe 67F35121CCF622E7A293C402219596FE6456CA4C3D27E6F8139E449264DA30F0. Other builds are unsupported; original x86 code runs directly via compatibility services. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
